items.title: Strangers united in tough bushland in last-ditch search for the Nannup Four

children.content: Armed with shovels, rakes and chainsaws, a team of citizen searchers are scouring a stretch of unforgiving bushland in southern Western Australia with one objective: find the remains of four people they've never met.

Chantelle McDougall, her daughter Leela, Simon Kadwill and Tony Popic vanished from the outskirts of the small West Australian town of Nannup in 2007. They left a note saying they were travelling to Brazil, but their passports had not been used and their bank accounts were untouched.
